title: CLI Serve Entrypoint Checker Accepts Hollow Implementations & Nonexistent Paths (Unchecked callsMain & Missing Path Verification)
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries.test.ts lines 316, 335, 357-380; verified by adversarial probe Probe 1 in docs/arch-improvement/cycle-7/live/task-5-guards/independent-review/adversarial-probes.test.ts
impact: The guard claims to verify real CLI serve delegation to runner, but callsMain is calculated and never evaluated before returning { isOk: true }. A CLI script that imports runner without ever calling main(args) erroneously passes. Furthermore, string matching without disk resolution passes references to nonexistent runner files and matches string literals in dummy variables/comments.

title: Workspace DAG Cycle Detector Relies Exclusively on package.json Manifests, Completely Blind to Cross-Package Source & Re-Export Cycles
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries.test.ts lines 771-789; verified by adversarial probe Probe 2 in docs/arch-improvement/cycle-7/live/task-5-guards/independent-review/adversarial-probes.test.ts
impact: The checker claims monorepo workspace DAG is strictly acyclic across workspace including re-exports. In reality, the live test only reads package.json dependencies. If Package A imports or re-exports Package B at the TypeScript source level while omitting the dependency in package.json, the graph edge is omitted and circular cross-package dependencies evade detection.

title: Suite 4 Evidence Generator Hardcodes Unconditional 'status: PASS' and 'coreBoundaryViolations: 0' Independent of Test Results
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries.test.ts lines 864-885; verified by adversarial probe Probe 3 in docs/arch-improvement/cycle-7/live/task-5-guards/independent-review/adversarial-probes.test.ts
impact: Because Node test runner continues executing subsequent test blocks after an assertion failure, a boundary violation in Suite 3 fails the test case, but Suite 4 still runs and writes report.json with hardcoded 'status': 'PASS', 'coreBoundaryViolations': 0, and 'workspaceAcyclic': true. CI or automated consumers inspecting report.json observe false green status.

title: AST Dependency Extractor Ignores Dynamic Import Template Literals, import = require, and Non-.ts Extensions
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries.test.ts lines 127-133, 454; verified by adversarial probe Probe 4 in docs/arch-improvement/cycle-7/live/task-5-guards/independent-review/adversarial-probes.test.ts
impact: ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0]) rejects no-substitution template literals (import(`@earendil-works/pi-durable`)), allowing forbidden dynamic vendor imports to bypass detection. TS import = require(...) is unhandled. collectAllSourceFiles only searches .ts, ignoring .mts, .cts, .js, and .tsx.
